From the logbook

Older entries →
  • 10 Nov
    Kell Bay moorings are backThe harbor trust has relaid twelve visitor moorings after the autumn gales. Pick up any yellow buoy and settle up at the chandlery.
  • 8 Nov
    Gannet Rock light is on reduced rangeThe lantern is running on its standby lamp until the spring refit. Expect eight miles of visibility instead of fourteen.
  • 5 Nov
    The winter ferry timetable starts MondayTwo sailings a day to Skerry Holm, weather permitting, leaving Port Avelin at 08:30 and 15:00.
  • 1 Nov
    Readers’ photographs: the first frostThank you for the two hundred pictures of rimed rigging. Our favorites run in the spring issue.
